name: Mabuchi Meiyou
source:
Acquainted-with-extroverts asocial type.
Reason for wanting to die: To make those he holds dear happy.
Lingering attachment to this world: Overcoming the fear of death.

An intelligent and composed guy with glasses. The vice president of the student council, and a second-year student who overflows with knowledge and humour. He’s a quick thinker and has a way with words so it’s easy for both extroverts and introverts to rely on him. He’s rumoured to be surprisingly passionate. In fact, he’s a hardcore romantic and a diehard Yuri fanboy who considers ‘women’ to be somewhat sacred.

Considered to be a perfectionist with an objective point of view and tends to have great esteem for what is clean, beautiful, and untainted. He’s clearly critical, even in a roundabout way, of anything that doesn’t fit those adjectives. He sometimes says or does things that suggest he has low self-esteem. In spite of this, his own opinions can come off as quite bold and polemical.

He is the eldest son of a family of four, living with his parents and younger sister.

[Adapted from [url=http://clubsuicide.net]the official website[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/_MORPATH?s=20&t=j3Xffhv5h-Yo19sJry3tvA]Twitter[/url].]
